description: Start here to make a React, Next.js or Django app global-ready (Vue, React Native/Expo and static HTML are beta). Scans the local project with the Babelize engine in dry-run mode on a temp copy: nothing is written, no network, no API key. Reports: framework and support level; whether the i18n library (next-intl / react-i18next / vue-i18n) is installed and wired up; hardcoded user-facing strings (count + file:line); JSX sentences kept whole as one ICU message vs split into pieces; strings that cannot be wired automatically and why; hardcoded dates/currencies/plurals; existing locale files and their coverage per locale; source keys that look unused (advisory); and next steps. Loop: babelize_analyze → babelize_translate → babelize_check (or babelize_review on a diff) → fix → repeat. Returns a short summary plus compact JSON; lists are capped by `limit`. Paths are relative to the project root.

locales.description: Target locales you plan to ship, e.g. ["de","ja"]; coverage is reported for them.

path.description: Project directory, relative to the workspace root (default: the workspace root). Must stay inside the workspace.

name: babelize_analyze
title: Analyze localization readiness
